name: record_payment_promise
description: Record a promise to pay. Only call after the customer has stated a date and you have read it back and they confirmed it. If they never gave a specific date, still call this with promise_date left empty and their exact words in notes. Never invent a date to make the call look successful.
pre_call_message: Ek second, main ye note kar leti hoon.

promise_date.description: The date the customer committed to, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Leave empty if they would not commit to a specific date.

promise_amount.description: The rupee amount they committed to, as digits. Leave empty if not stated. Never estimate.

notes.description: The customer's own words, verbatim, if the promise was vague
